extensions.text: Zenziwe abanye, zengeza kulokho ongakwenza lapha. Ngasinye sisebenza sodwa ngaphandle kwamafayela akho nokhiye, ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, futhi senza kuphela lokho okuvumelayo.
extensions.addText: Noma ubani angasenza. Umsizi {name} usifunda kuqala futhi akubonise lokho esikucelayo, ngaphambi kokuthi kungezwe lutho.
extensions.addHint: Ikheli lefolda yaso, noma lekhasi laso ku-GitHub.
extensions.right.change: Ukushintsha lokho esikubonayo ngaphambi kokuthi kuqhubeke
extensions.right.loosen: Ukuvumela izenzo ziqhubeke ngaphandle kokukubuza kuqala
extensions.rightText.watch: Konke okubhalwe kuzo, amafayela owabelana ngawo, nesenzo ngasinye ngaphambi kokuthi siqale
extensions.rightText.loosen: Neze iphasiwedi noma inkokhelo, noma ngaphezu komthetho osethwe yinhlangano yakho
extensions.onceText: Uma kukhona okungalungile selokhu wengeza esisodwa
extensions.error.name: Igama laso lingaba nezinhlamvu ezincane, izinombolo namadeshi kuphela.
extensions.error.main: Ikhodi yaso kufanele ibe yifayela le-JavaScript eliseduze ne-extension.json yaso.
extensions.safe: Imodi ephephile: asikho isengezo esisebenzayo kulokhu kuvakasha.
extensions.confirmRemove: Susa isengezo {title}? Lokho esikugcinile kuhamba naso.
